description: The Transportation Equity Dashboard of TransitCenter tracks access to opportunities by public transit and by car for residents of seven US cities, and shows how transit access changes over time as schedules change. Users can explore access to opportunity and other transit data on a map, compare distributive equity across groups with interactive charts, and download the data. The site argues that transit riders, and especially riders of different race, income, gender and ability, have far lower access than car users because of funding choices. A banner says the dashboard is not fully complete and data should be used with caution. Coverage: seven US cities. Format and access: web maps, charts and downloads. Licence and cost: free; no licence is stated. Caveats: incomplete and advocacy-oriented. It supports equity analysis in capacity planning and network design of transit. It relates to the r5r accessibility model and the National Transit Database in the catalogue.
